transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because, for the past year or so, I just feel like I’m always puttering. Fixing things around the house, arranging things... volunteering for one more thing. Even at 87, I just... I have a hard time just sitting down and being still. That's really it.
During this period, have you felt unusually cheerful or high in your mood?
No, not really. Just my normal self, I suppose. Just... busy.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot more than you think you should?
No, I wouldn't say so. I mean, I worry about normal things, I suppose. But not... not an unusual amount.
Have you been sleeping less than usual without feeling tired?
No... I sleep my usual amount, I suppose. I definitely feel tired when it's time for bed.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day?
No, not really. I feel... fine, mostly. Just normal.
Has this tendency to stay busy and have trouble sitting still been part of your personality for most of your life?

I suppose it has. Yes. Even back in... well, grade school, I remember getting scolded. Just for popping out of my seat, mostly. Or talking over the other classmates. I was told I was just too lively... long before I was even a teenager. So, yes. Always been that way, I guess.
Has this lifelong restlessness ever caused serious problems in your daily life, like at work, in relationships, or managing responsibilities?

Well... I don't know about serious problems. But, yes, it does cause some friction. At the senior center, I mean. I've had to... apologize, sometimes, after our committee meetings. And recently, a friend of mine... well, she suggested I might want to step back from the sign-up table. Take a smaller role. She said my... my manner was just making things a bit tense for people. So... yes, I suppose it does affect things.
Have you ever had a period of several days or longer when you felt unusually energized or overly confident compared with your usual self?
No... I don't believe so. I just feel like my usual self, really. I wouldn't say I ever get overly confident or... anything like that. Just normal.
